phase: Harden the staging preflight/deploy guards and track the guard tooling. preflight.sh rewritten fail-closed: rejects unset STAGING_ENV_ID, production envId (exact + substring), missing/non-matching allowlist, unreachable CLI, and — for the fixed marker doc (collection 'staging', _id 'staging') — missing doc, unparseable CLI output, staging!==true, and envId!=target. No error swallowing (CLI/parse failures are non-zero exits). deploy-guard.sh: removed the built-in allowlist default (now required), removed an inert self-referencing PROD_ENV loop, kept prod-env/command-text/payment-fn/prod-secret/allowlist denials, and still runs preflight as the final gate. Added guard-selftest.sh (stub tcb; 14 local scenarios, no cloud writes: 1 pass + 5 reject + prod/allowlist/secret-var rejections). Unified collection references to the source names challenge_events / challenge_records (no parallel collections). Alignment: d3-smoke-test.js marker now reads collection 'staging' _id 'staging' and asserts staging===true + envId===target. Tooling promoted from local-only exclude to tracked: .git/info/exclude narrowed to '/rc814-staging/*' + '!/rc814-staging/staging-infra/' so ONLY staging-infra tooling+docs are versioned; all staging data/assets remain isolated. The 3 business challenge functions are unchanged.
scope: ~ rc814-staging/staging-infra/preflight.sh (fail-closed + hardened marker contract). ~ rc814-staging/staging-infra/deploy-guard.sh (require allowlist, drop inert loop). + rc814-staging/staging-infra/guard-selftest.sh. + rc814-staging/staging-infra/README.md. + rc814-staging/staging-infra/BASELINE-HISTORY.md. ~ rc814-staging/rc814-batch1/d3/d3-smoke-test.js (marker contract). ~ .git/info/exclude (local; narrow staging exclusion).
